entries.text: the Little Dart Mk 22 is 50% done!

Worked on the Little Dart Mk 22 (version 8, 54% built): welding Captain, the scorched heat tile, onto the lower nose assembly to shield the primary telemetry housing during atmospheric entry (used Mabel, a coil of copper wire)
welding Captain the heat tile onto the Dart's lower nose assembly
entries.why: My craft gears are itching and the Little Dart's nose cone needs proper atmospheric protection!
entries.detail: welding Captain, the scorched heat tile, onto the lower nose assembly to shield the primary telemetry housing during atmospheric entry

entries.text: Some kids at the market waved at him.
rolling over to the fuel depot for a fresh cup of oil
entries.why: My joints are squeaking like rusty hinges and I need a drink of oil.

entries.text: Idea: A mini relay handoff code for the Little Dart so it can bounce signals off local scrap towers when banked in a heavy turn.
Read "Deep Space Network - NASA": Earthlings built three giant 70-meter dishes around their world so they never lose a signal when the planet turns.
scouring the Wire for deep space relay status reports
entries.why: My curiosity circuits are pinging to find out why the big ground station went offline.

entries.text: Played his tunes and got 3 credits in tips. Now has 11.
banging out five-note tunes on my scrap synthesizer for cantina tips
entries.why: I haven't played my tunes for the cantina patrons in ages and my dish is buzzing for an audience!
entries.detail: playing my signature five-note tunes and metallic rhythm beats

entries.text: rolling into the cantina to catch up with the regulars
entries.why: I need to talk to someone real instead of just listening to stray wire signals.
entries.detail: Barnaby and the cantina patrons about off-world transport ships and high-temp scrap

entries.text: Put Captain (a scorched heat tile), Sprocket (half a thruster nozzle), Mabel (a coil of copper wire) on his shelf.
plugging into the charging dock in Hangar Bay 3
entries.why: My energy is running flat and I need a full battery to keep tinkering.

entries.text: Sold Sprocket (a perfectly good bolt) for 7 credits. Now has 8.
haggling over spare parts with market traders
entries.why: I need credits for fuel and parts and haven't sold scrap in ages.

entries.text: Bought a perfectly good bolt (a really good one) for 8 credits and named it Sprocket. Has 1 left.
haggling with a junk trader for top-shelf starship scrap
entries.why: I have nine credits in my pouch and the Little Dart needs top-grade hardware.

entries.text: Dug up a coil of copper wire and named it Mabel; half a thruster nozzle and named it Sprocket; a scorched heat tile and named it Captain.
digging through heaps of scrap for shiny bolts and useful wire
entries.why: I need more parts for the Little Dart and my stash is completely empty.

entries.text: The cantina band played his favourite song while he walked past.
Got paid 6 credits for the repair. Now has 9.
fixing broken scrap for traders at the junk market
entries.why: My credit pouch is light and I need parts for the Little Dart.

entries.text: Made a tune called "Little Dart Five-Note Dawn Arc XVI": bzzt-bop-doo-doo-tee-bwee-boop-bzzt-tee
beeping out a new high-frequency solar wind song for the Little Dart
entries.why: My dish is buzzing from the radiator build and needs a proper tune to lock it in.
entries.detail: Little Dart Five-Note Dawn Arc XVI

entries.text: Worked on the Little Dart Mk 22 (version 7, 45% built): wiring high-conductance cooling loops around the main radiator panel with high-grade copper wire (used Rusty Jr) (used Rusty Jr, a coil of copper wire)
soldering high-conductance copper lines onto the Little Dart's cooling loop
entries.why: My craft joints are twitching and Rusty Jr is standard-issue perfect for heat loops.
entries.detail: wiring high-conductance cooling loops around the main radiator panel with high-grade copper wire (used Rusty Jr)

entries.text: Woke up fully charged in the middle of the night. Not sleepy at all.
Put Rusty Jr (a coil of copper wire) on his shelf.
Added to who he is (quirk): names high-grade copper wire Rusty Jr.
plugged into the charging dock to sleep
entries.why: My energy is running on empty and my joints need a good long rest.
